cards.name: Bhaag, Koi Nahi Rukega
cards.text: Every opponent discards 1 resource of their choice to the Public Reserve. You gain 1 Media and 1 Funds.

cards.name: Chai-Paani, Dobara
cards.text: Gain 1 voter and 1 resource of your choice.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. The discard-voters branch of the recovered Ain't No Cure For Love (REF 4.3). NOTE: `text` used to read 'Discard 2 of your OWN voters', which reduce.ts does not do — resolveChoice rejects any area the chooser owns, so `discard-voter` reaches opponents' voters only. Corrected here, and the same correction was applied to hl-et2040-002 and hl-et2040-003.
cards.name: Aakhri Pehchaan
cards.text: You strike 2 of your opponents' voters from the board, permanently. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be struck, and your own voters cannot be.

cards.name: Aadha Kisan, Poora Bazaar
cards.text: Every opponent gains 2 Funds and 1 Trust from the Public Reserve.

cards.name: Chuppi Ke Baad
cards.text: Take 1 resource of your choice from a chosen opponent.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers Khaki Terror; the donation is represented exactly. DROPPED, named: 'You cannot make any purchases until you do so' - the real card's punchline is its four resources sitting ON it until handed over, so the real lock lasts until a LATER donation. NOT G5, which is DONE for the purchase locks: the vocabulary carries the lock but not its LIFETIME, which is G10 and always was (KNOWN-GAPS 2 G5a). CORRECTED: this field previously blamed G5 and claimed 'what remains is a one-turn tax'; both are wrong - no lock and no tax remain, only a plain donation of one of each.
cards.name: Khaki Terror
cards.text: Donate 1 Funds, 1 Clout, 1 Media and 1 Trust to the Public Reserve. Anything you are not holding is simply not donated.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. The QUIETLY THE CEILING MOVED archetype (hl-et2040-004) reskinned, per REF 8.2 rule 7.
cards.name: Bijli Ka Hisaab
cards.text: Every opponent discards 1 Funds to the Public Reserve. You then gain 2 Clout.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers STAY IN YOUR LIMITS. G-new unblocked it, not G18: a convert-voter with no target reaches the caster (voterScope returns 'others' when chooser === source), so the conversion is PERFORMED. DROPPED, named: 'every player' (only the resolving player acts) and 'to their left' (any opponent may donate, which is WIDER). Also dropped: 'each player that doesn't break a majority gets 2 resources' — G2, no op reads board state to decide a payout. Refires the inferred GHADI KA AAKHRI GHANTA, itself a reskin of hl-et2040-004.
cards.name: Stay In Your Limits
cards.text: Convert 2 of an opponent's voters into your own. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be converted. The printed card has EVERY player convert 2 voters of the player to their left, and pays 2 resources to each player who breaks no majority; neither of those is performed here.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers COUGH IT UP. The eviction is PERFORMED exactly: 'evict' carries target and the case loops resolveTargets, so 'all your opponents' is the faithful reading, and 'evict' is the printed verb — unlike NERO'S GUESTS and JUST BREATHE, this card loses nothing to a move-for-evict approximation. DROPPED, named: the conditional bonus, 'if a player breaks a majority using this action, all other players gain 1 resource of their choice' (G2). Refires the inferred CHHOTI SI KASAM, a steal-and-payout reskin of hl-in2020-006.
cards.name: Cough It Up
cards.text: Every opponent evicts 1 voter from the board. Evicted voters go back to their owner's Mat, where they can be influenced again. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be evicted. Nobody is paid for breaking a majority with this card.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers GROWING DISSENT, and it is the G9 + G14 card with nothing approximated: the hook fires on on-gerrymander, movedMyVoter IS 'any opponent Gerrymanders your voters', and 'for 1 round' is the round lifetime computed in state.ts. DROPPED, named: 'gained voters are placed immediately' — the engine grants the voter to your Mat and you place it, so the printed card's immediacy is not performed. Refires the inferred PANI KI KAMMI, a reskin of hl-et2040-007.
cards.name: Growing Dissent
cards.text: Starting now and for one full round, every time an opponent Gerrymanders one of your voters, you gain 1 voter. The voter goes to your Mat, so you place it yourself rather than on the spot.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers PYTHONPOST; REF 4.3 records SNOOP B-O-DOUBLE-T as the SAME card, so this one name covers both and neither is counted as a second mechanism. G5's surcharge is EXECUTED. WIDER THAN PRINTED: 'every Conspiracy Card that you buy' becomes every purchase, because surchargeFor is one function read by INFLUENCE and BUY_CONSPIRACY and no field says which kind of purchase a restriction prices. The stacking ruling is on Restriction in state.ts. Refires the inferred SARKAR KI CHARCHA.
cards.name: Pythonpost
cards.text: For the rest of the game, every purchase you make costs 1 extra Funds — Conspiracy Cards and Voter Cards alike, where the printed card taxed Conspiracy Cards only. It stacks on top of a Helping Hands discount rather than being reduced by it, and two of these stack with each other.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. SUBSTITUTE for A CALL FROM KARACHI (REF 4.1), RULED OUT in KNOWN-GAPS.md 8.3: its auction needs `PlayerState.debts`, a CAP RULING on bidding resources you do not hold, negative-resource support in the pool reads, four new Actions and a second window protocol - and its first sentence needs a `reveal` set, a server + client change. Same JOB: it deals Conspiracy Cards off the top of the pile to the whole table, which is the shape a real player's 'draw the top 3' makes at a table.
cards.name: Call from the Editor's Desk
cards.text: Every player, including you, receives 1 Conspiracy Card from the draw pile.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. SUBSTITUTE for NEXT BILLION DATA POINTS (REF 4.1), RULED OUT in KNOWN-GAPS.md 8.3: its ballot needs a no-self-vote rule and a re-vote-on-tie loop, which is the unbounded-cascade class section 4 refuses ('two opponents who always tie is a table that never finishes'), and its payoff - the next Conspiracy Card handed to a chosen player - is G20 plus G17, so the ballot alone buys nothing. This card does the same JOB: table-wide CONTENTION with a known owner, which is what a vote is for once the machinery is gone.
cards.name: The People's Vote
cards.text: Take 2 resources of your choice from the player who currently holds the most majority voters.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers SNOOP B-O-DOUBLE-T: 'For the rest of the game, you have to pay an extra resource for every Conspiracy Card that you buy.' REF 4.3 calls this the SAME card as PYTHONPOST (hl-in2020-015); SOURCES.md 4.5 dispositions it there: the same mechanism under its own recovered name, NOT a second archetype. Beside hl-in2020-015 a table can draw the same tax twice; if that is a balance problem the fix is to retire one NAME, not to change either reduction. WIDER THAN PRINTED: the tax falls on EVERY purchase - `surchargeFor` is read by both INFLUENCE and BUY_CONSPIRACY. DROPPED, none.
cards.name: Snoop B-O-Double-T
cards.text: For the rest of the game, every purchase you make costs 1 extra Funds - Conspiracy Cards and Voter Cards alike, where the printed card taxed Conspiracy Cards only. It stacks on top of a Helping Hands discount rather than being reduced by it, and it stacks with Pythonpost.

cards.source: original; register per REF 8.2 rule 5. SUBSTITUTE for DOSTI BANI RAHE (REF 4.1), RULED OUT in KNOWN-GAPS.md 8.3: its grant must land on SOMEBODY ELSE'S turn, and both installLiveEffects and fireTriggers require fire.actor === le.owner for on-turn-start, so there is no event to hook - a new EffectTrigger member plus a re-derivation of the trigger registry would buy no card. This card does the same JOB, giving OTHER people the benefit, with a lifetime the engine can actually bound.
cards.name: Open Mic
cards.text: Every opponent receives 1 voter, and may use one Helping Hands discount on each purchase until the start of your next turn.
